# Typst fonts and asset licenses

Hibi's Typst plugin includes fonts and other assets from `typst-assets` 0.14.2, used by `@myriaddreamin/typst-ts-node-compiler` 0.7.0. The original notices and license are copied below without changes.

## Sources

- [Compiler 0.7.0 source and dependency versions](https://github.com/Myriad-Dreamin/typst.ts/blob/7220b3229f51b7df599b2dc3f2c86a3feb4c994e/Cargo.lock)
- [Typst assets 0.14.2 package](https://crates.io/crates/typst-assets/0.14.2)
- [Original notices](https://github.com/typst/typst-assets/blob/38eadb63561c7481e08520732a3f10b926473d1f/NOTICE) and [license](https://github.com/typst/typst-assets/blob/38eadb63561c7481e08520732a3f10b926473d1f/LICENSE)
